photo_restyle_plain.prompt:
Redesign the interior of the provided photo (a living room) into a photorealistic, professionally photographed result.

STRUCTURE (never change): keep exactly the same camera position, angle, lens, framing and perspective, the same layout and architecture - wall positions, ceiling height, floor area, windows, doors, openings, stairs, beams and built-in fixtures - and the same proportions. Do not add, remove, move or resize any structural element or window. Keep the direction and brightness of the natural light.

MODE restyle: keep the existing furniture where it is, with the same placement, size and shape. Change only its finishes, upholstery, materials, colours, textiles and the decor, so it looks like the same room, restyled.

STYLE: Moroccan: zellige tiles, carved plaster and arches, brass lanterns, handwoven berber rugs, low majlis seating, cedar and tadelakt textures.

QUALITY: high-end interior photography, realistic materials with accurate textures, soft natural lighting with consistent shadows and reflections, sharp detail, balanced exposure. No text, no watermark, no people, no distortion, no extra windows or doors, no cartoon or illustration look.

FINAL CHECK: the picture must show the Marocain style.
